name: v2026.1001.0
body:
# Paperclip v2026.1001.0

> Released: 2026-10-01

Paperclip v2026.1001.0 carries 77 commits, promoted from `2026.921.0-beta.1`. The headline is reliability: a deep hardening pass over the native runner and chat recovery — approval and Stop races, session continuity, sandbox reconnection and cleanup — alongside a friendlier face: agent personas throughout the app, an animated onboarding character, and a rebuilt Slack setup. Around those: agents can review GitHub pull requests as scheduled review bots, Railway joins the connector catalog with governed deployment tools, approvals and answers queue during active runs instead of bouncing, and execution harnesses now default to full auto.

## Breaking Changes

- **The legacy Composio broker is retired.** The API-key catalog method, broker clients, session creation, account synchronization, child lifecycle and toolkit routes, and the Services tab are all removed. Existing legacy Composio connections stop working, and there is no automated migration — the experimental MCP aggregator connectors (below) are the successor path; see the Upgrade Guide for the manual steps. Vercel provenance is untouched. ([#13758](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13758))
- **Execution harnesses now default to full auto.** Native runs default Claude/ACPX to `approve-all`, OpenCode to `allow`, and Codex to approval-and-sandbox bypass, and the legacy adapters follow the same policy — provider tools and connected tools included. Explicitly configured restrictive modes are preserved, and Paperclip's own approval decisions still enforce controller authority; only the *defaults* change. Operators who relied on unconfigured agents inheriting restrictive provider gates should set an explicit mode. ([#13686](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13686), [#13693](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13693))

## Highlights

- **Agents get faces** — Static persona images replace agent icons across lists, the sidebar, org charts, tasks, comments, selectors, activity, and dashboards, with one animated pointer-following character in the agent header (reduced-motion and touch fallbacks included) and persona reveal built into agent creation ([#13171](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13171)). Onboarding opens with the ClipLab sleepy-to-wake hero: the character dozes in gray through setup and wakes in full palette on Review ([#13629](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13629)). Slack setup can download the agent's avatar as a PNG for the bot identity, from both setup and settings ([#13740](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13740)).
- **Agents review your pull requests** — A guided setup turns a Paperclip agent into a GitHub review bot: a copyable Claude/Codex prompt walks through App installation, review scheduling, and optional required checks, with the instance origin baked in ([#13717](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13717)). The GitHub MCP connection also gains the Actions toolset — workflow discovery and dispatch — for existing and new connections ([#13553](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13553)).
- **Approvals and answers queue during active runs** — Responding to a question or approval while the agent is mid-run no longer bounces: resolved cards project into the run queue as immutable responses, an explicit click steers a response into a compatible native turn (or interrupts for a fresh session), and typed context survives interruption and cleanup ([#13539](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13539)).
- **Slack setup, rebuilt** — Onboarding splits into six clickable steps with a generated creation link and read-only manifest, credential validation, live account-link status, and a mention-based message test ([#13638](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13638)). Companies can attach communication guidance to a Slack connection that follows conversations into tasks without per-turn reminders ([#13760](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13760)), and callback health reports correctly behind Cloud proxies ([#13694](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13694)).
- **The connector catalog grows** — Railway arrives with OAuth setup and governed deployment tools: service and deployment status, bounded logs, and redeploy/restart/rollback, with workspace-verified access ([#13415](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13415)). Experimental MCP aggregators (Zapier, Arcade, Composio Connect, Executor) land behind the default-off `enableMcpAggregators` flag, reusing the existing vault, grants, and policy models ([#13755](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13755)). You.com search joins the self-serve catalog with sign-in, API-key, and keyless free tiers ([#13555](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13555)), and a CreateOS sandbox provider plugin implements the full environment lifecycle against the CreateOS HTTP API ([#13434](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13434)).
- **Routines get safe webhooks** — A production trigger wizard adds schedule and webhook choices, one-time credentials, test delivery receipts, and reversible removal ([#13637](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13637)), and a warning banner flags webhook URLs that may not be publicly reachable — localhost, private networks, HTTP, and Tailscale Serve vs Funnel ([#13684](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13684)).
- **Skills from work, and for onboarding** — A runner tool turns a completed task's learnings into a company skill, validated and governed by the existing skill policy ([#13538](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13538)); the first onboarding task runs through a dedicated skill invoked natively on Claude and Codex ([#13517](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13517)); and an eval guide plus skill-authoring skills join the docs ([#13535](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13535)).
- **Plugins load image catalogs** — Catalog identities, confined paths, package versions, and bundle hashes are validated before importing code; image selection applies to persisted installs with removal and rollback; and persistent application overlays mount in both UI shells ([#13646](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13646)).

## Fixes

- **Task conversation and UI** — The chat composer no longer starts out disabled on desktop while the pause-status check is pending (shipped early as stable [2026.916.1](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/releases/tag/v2026.916.1); [#13562](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13562)). Selecting a single-choice option answers the question without auto-advancing the page ([#13602](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13602)), every copy button now confirms only after the clipboard write succeeds ([#13603](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13603)), task history stays visible while retries wait to start ([#13597](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13597)), the latest failed attempt is retryable even when later automatic retries were cancelled ([#13765](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13765)), and the connections sign-in screen stops adding a phantom step ([#13601](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13601)).
- **Runner and native execution reliability** — A broad hardening pass across the native runner: approval and Stop races settle correctly during cleanup ([#13750](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13750)), a pending startup is awaited before a Stop is acknowledged so a late handle can't submit a provider turn ([#13741](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13741)), provider sessions persist across turns with question and approval continuations completing on the same run ([#13655](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13655)), task replies and warm process continuity survive deduplication and helper-thread noise ([#13738](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13738)), and Agent Chat recovery keeps wake-comment identity and rejects stale retries ([#13678](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13678)). Sandbox operations got sturdier too: Daytona sessions reconnect after a controller restart with PID-reuse-proof adoption checks ([#13691](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13691)), termination keeps progressing after bridge loss with fenced cleanup attempts ([#13287](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13287)), leases stranded active by a restart are swept ([#13515](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13515)), inherited environments are validated and stale sandbox binaries replaced ([#13677](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13677)), catalog runtime and grading boundaries are repaired ([#13676](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13676)), completion-tool rejections name the missing fields ([#13682](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13682)), and native review handoffs complete with server-validated assignment facts and narrowly scoped reviewer tools ([#13581](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13581)). Also: plugin workers reach issue-tree resume ([#13757](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13757)), projects without workspace configuration honor the operator's isolation default ([#13636](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13636)), managed Git launchers work in sandbox projects ([#13588](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13588)), an empty `GROK_HOME` no longer masks the host login for local Grok runs ([#13570](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13570)), and Claude ACP quota classification and reset times survive to the adapter boundary ([#13651](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13651)).
- **Connection and notification recovery** — Authentication and browser connection failures recover: `CONNECT_TIMEOUT` joins the retry policy, WebSocket constructor failures are handled, and visible queries poll every 15 seconds while the company socket is down ([#13724](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13724)). Finalized run failures stop re-notifying on every reconnect ([#13739](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13739)), and chat latency drops while managed session reuse is preserved ([#13710](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13710)).
- **Server correctness** — PostgreSQL recovers after a transaction connection closes instead of wedging queued queries ([#13643](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13643)), malformed JSON requests get a constant safe 400 instead of echoing submitted bytes into errors and crash reports ([#13660](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13660)), heartbeat run IDs are validated before database lookups ([#13657](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13657)), agent-chat views skip task-only connector reads ([#13654](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13654)), a caught-up log reader gets an empty read instead of a past-EOF range error ([#13592](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13592)), and Sentry errors attribute to the loaded source release on both server and browser ([#13719](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13719)).
- **Cloud-instance URL correctness** — Task links handed to external chats are exact public URLs ([#13699](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13699)), and chat setup, Telegram registration, and GitHub webhook recovery all use the claimed Cloud origin, with self-hosted configuration precedence preserved ([#13680](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13680)).
- **CLI and local logins** — The onboarding wizard accepts prompt defaults instead of rejecting the empty input they display ([#13520](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13520)), and a macOS isolated Claude login is read from its suffixed Keychain item when the credentials file is missing ([#13519](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13519)).

## Improvements

- Continuation prompts are shorter for legacy and native runners, with question-tool guidance living in the canonical descriptor ([#13574](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13574)); connector setup copy says "organization" ([#13589](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13589)); chat connector UX conventions are documented for provider authors ([#13675](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13675)); DeepWiki is configured as a 30-page contributor handbook ([#13745](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13745)); and the database package ships without historical drizzle snapshots ([#13687](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13687)).

## Upgrade Guide

- **Migrations `0280`–`0283`** run on upgrade (agent personas, routine webhooks, Slack communication guidance, GitHub review bots).
- **Legacy Composio connections are removed, with no automated migration** ([#13758](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13758)). Enabling the experimental `enableMcpAggregators` flag only exposes the replacement Composio Connect catalog entry — it does not carry over existing credentials, grants, or access rules. To keep Composio-backed integrations: enable the flag, create and authorize a new Composio Connect MCP connection, re-select its access rules, and remove each retired legacy connection record. Until that is done, agents lose access to the retired tools.
- **Execution defaults changed to full auto** ([#13686](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13686), [#13693](https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/pull/13693)): set an explicit restrictive mode on agents that must keep provider-side approval gates.
- No other configuration or API changes require action.

name: Niubash v1.2.5
body:
Niubash v1.2.5 Windows packages.

Engine: rubash git c2f8e8a67670
Verify locally with `niu --version`, which prints the same revision.

Packages are built remotely for x64 and ARM64. Portable zip packages remain available, and installer packages add user PATH and Windows Terminal profile integration.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/compare/v1.2.4...v1.2.5

## Release Notes

Released on 2026-10-01.

### Python

- Add CPython 3.10.22, 3.11.17, 3.12.15, 3.13.16, and 3.14.8 ([#22147](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22147))

### Enhancements

- Accept uppercase release suffixes in wheel platform tags ([#22113](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22113))
- Record workspace-member default groups in lockfiles ([#22010](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22010), [#22103](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22103))
- Record workspace-member dependency-group Python requirements in lockfiles ([#22044](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22044), [#22103](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22103))
- Record default groups for non-project workspace roots in lockfiles ([#22104](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22104))
- Record dependency-group Python requirements for non-project workspace roots in lockfiles ([#22104](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22104))
- Format URLs and paths consistently in CLI messages ([#21937](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21937))
- Hide the unsupported `--offline` option from `uv publish` help ([#22124](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22124))

### Preview features

- Honor `--no-default-groups` in `uv audit` ([#22090](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22090))
- Report a clear error when `uv audit` or `uv tool audit` runs offline and hide the unsupported option from help ([#22114](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22114))

### Configuration

- Add `UV_PYTHON_ARCH` to select an interpreter architecture independently of its Python version ([#22098](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22098))

### Performance

- Reduce uv's binary size by compressing embedded Python download metadata ([#22126](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22126))

### Bug fixes

- Verify unchanged requirements against existing lockfile hashes when relocking ([#22083](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22083))
- Honor dependency-group Python requirements at non-project workspace roots ([#22101](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22101))
- Use each selected workspace member's recorded default groups during frozen sync ([#22015](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22015))
- Avoid false entry-point warnings for required workspace members ([#22112](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22112))

### Other changes

- Raise the minimum supported Rust version for building uv to 1.97 and update the toolchain to Rust 1.99 ([#22121](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22121))

## Install uv 0.12.22

name: Sub2API 0.2.12
body:
> AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

新增 TypeSafe Jev System One 原生平台支持；充值页新增优惠阶梯，支持「赠金」与「折扣」两种模式。

## 新增功能

- TypeSafe 平台：原生支持 Jev System One（/v1/systemone），含账号创建与测试、分组/渠道/配额/Composite 路由、计费、内容审核与提示词审计覆盖
- 充值优惠阶梯：后台可配置「满 X 送 Y%」赠金或「满 X 打折」折扣模式及 Markdown 活动文案，充值页快捷金额显示促销价签，订单与支付结果展示赠送额度
- 账号列表优先级快捷调整：悬停显示 -/+ 按钮、点击可直接输入，连续点击自动合并为一次保存
- API 密钥列表支持按分组名称排序

## 优化改进

- Grok OAuth 请求身份头对齐官方交互式 CLI 1.0.46

## Bug 修复

- 修复 Grok 因 CLI 版本过低返回 426 的问题
- 修复 Antigravity 上游错误体原样返回给客户端、可能泄露账号池项目 ID 与服务账号邮箱的问题
- 修复邮箱验证码并发猜测可突破 5 次尝试上限的问题；重置密码 token 改为哈希存储并原子单次消费
- 匿名订单查询接口 /payment/public/orders/verify 增加按 IP 限流（20 次/分钟），防止订单号枚举
- 修正账号「自定义错误码」设置的警告文案，准确描述其实际作用

## 升级指南

- 本版本包含数据库迁移（payment_orders 新增 bonus_amount 列、平台约束加入 typesafe），启动时自动执行
- 重置密码 token 改为哈希存储，升级前已发出但尚未使用的重置密码链接将失效，用户需重新申请



---

## 📥 Installation

**Docker:**
```bash
# Docker Hub
docker pull weishaw/sub2api:0.2.12

# GitHub Container Registry
docker pull ghcr.io/wei-shaw/sub2api:0.2.12
```

```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash
```

name: v0.4.23
body:
# OpenViking v0.4.23

## 中文

### 亮点

- 检索与排序：每条查询改为一次全局向量召回，再按模式统一 rerank，移除目录递归与父级分数传播，评分阈值在 rerank 之后应用（#5450）；移除热度加权及 `retrieval.hotness_alpha`（#5454）；`find` / `search` 新增事件时间衰减排序参数 `events_time_decay_protection`（#5214）；`search` 新增 `search_type="keywords"` BM25 关键词检索，覆盖 REST、MCP、CLI 与 Python / TypeScript / Go SDK（#5456）；Jev rerank 新增 Choice 模式，通过 `rerank.mode: "choice"` 启用，默认仍为 `noul`；Choice 分数是候选池内的相对概率，启用时需把 `rerank.threshold` 设为 `0`，MCP 调用同时传 `min_score=0`（#5486）；observer 报告向量度量与分数尺度（#5488）。
- 文件系统与知识整理：`ls` / `tree` 返回 `has_more` 分页状态（#5330）；`tree` 支持 `directories_only` 目录过滤和 L0/L1 展示（#5334）；`ls` 支持 `include_abstract` / `include_overview`（#5434）；`ov compile --skill memory` 对记忆目录就地去重、合并与规范化（#5178）；`reindex` 迁移到 RFV planner，新增 `force`，异步任务可恢复，`queue_workers.reindex.max_concurrent` 默认 `4`（#5416）；snapshot 处理文件被目录替换的情况（#5441）；Markdown 解析保留首个一级标题之前的内容（#5427），飞书表格转义竖线与换行（#5435）。
- MCP、权限与 Studio：MCP 工具声明行为注解（#5075），整次调用失败时返回 `isError: true`（#5078）；新增 `list_users`、`list_groups`、`get_acl`、`set_acl` 工具，`write` / `add_resource` 支持 `acl` 参数（#5466）；账号变更缺少注册表基线时拒绝写入，避免覆盖已有账号（#5483）；`ovcli.conf` 接受 `oidc_token`（#5448）；Studio 新增账号级记忆抽取规则编辑（#5495）。
- 模型与向量服务：gpt-6 及之后的 OpenAI 模型按推理模型处理，修复 session commit 返回 400（#5398）；火山、Ark 媒体响应和 Anthropic（LiteLLM）支持透传额外请求体（#5432、#5440、#5447）；Gemini 异步客户端按请求创建，修复 `attached to a different loop`（#5428）；Jina 默认维度按模型推导（#5426）；内存 cache provider 拒绝 Lua 脚本（#5446）。
- Agent 插件：采集过滤统一为「清洗 → 过滤 → 截断」，pi / Codex / DSH / OpenCode / Claude Code 共用（#5359、#5375）；Claude Code 与 Codex 召回钩子转发 `recallExcludeUris`（#5407），pi 支持 `recallExcludeUris` / `recallQueryFilters`（#5368）；Codex 采集排除宿主注入的启动上下文（#5392）；pi `/viking commit` 未归档时给出原因（#5468）；pi 与 OpenCode 随插件附带 OpenViking skills（#5525）；新增 `ov-kanban` skill 用于结构化任务交接（#5157、#5451）；DSH 增加插件卡片图标与多语言描述（#5362）、按会话解析 workspace peer 设置（#5380）；Hermes 修复召回绑定当前会话、setup 时保留 `.env` 其他内容等问题（#5372、#5374、#5449、#5455）。
- 安装：安装器只从发布渠道安装，不再 `git clone`，改动前先列出并确认（#5464）；安装包改由文档站下载，`docs.openviking.net` 与 `docs.openviking.ai` 谁先响应用谁（#5477、#5487）；默认同时安装 `ov` CLI（#5498）；先询问语言并清理旧安装器遗留（#5490）；指南与插件 README 的安装入口统一为 `openviking.ai/install`（#5478）。
- CLI、文档与品牌：CLI 采用 E 品牌标志与纯色配色（#5545）；README 改为 agent-first 快速开始，并加入火山 OpenViking Service 产品页入口（#5524）；文档站对照实现逐页校对（#5501–#5511、#5533、#5534）；开源字体排版（#5536、#5543）与 E 品牌（#5537、#5546）。
- 其他修复：Windows + uv 等经中间启动器运行 Bot 时，就绪状态被误判导致主服务等待 900 秒（#5431）。

### 兼容性与迁移

1. **Session 自动 commit 配置项合并（#5363）**：`memory.session_auto_commit.default_enabled` 与 `idle_enabled` 合并为 `enabled`（默认 `false`）。旧键名不兼容，会被忽略，启动日志只有一条 `Ignoring unknown config field` WARNING，不会报错；配过旧键的部署升级后自动 commit 会关闭，需要改成 `enabled: true`。同一配置下，`scan_batch_size`、`scan_batch_pause_seconds` 一并移除，由 `scan_rate_limit_files_per_second`（默认 `2.0`）取代；`check_interval_seconds` 默认值由 `60` 秒改为 `600` 秒。

   ```json
   { "memory": { "session_auto_commit": { "enabled": true } } }
   ```

2. **已知问题：`find` 传非法参数返回 500，而不是 400**：`limit` 为负数时，本地向量库后端和 VikingDB 后端都会返回 500（本地后端是 native 检索接口收到负数 topk 后整数溢出）；`limit=0` 在 VikingDB 后端返回 500，本地后端返回空结果（来自 #5450）。VikingDB 后端下 `filter` 条件不带 `op` 也会返回 500（v0.4.22 起已有）。后续版本会补参数校验；在此之前请由调用方保证 `limit >= 1`，且 `filter` 条件带 `op`。

3. **检索评分与排序变化（#5450、#5454）**：召回由逐层递归 + 父级分数传播改为单次全局召回；仅在启用 rerank 时候选池放大到 `2 × limit`，统一 rerank 一次，rerank 失败沿用向量分数。`retrieval.hotness_alpha` 与 `score_propagation_alpha` 配置已删除，配置中保留会被忽略并输出 WARNING；排序只取向量分数或 rerank 分数。同一查询的结果顺序和分数可能与 v0.4.22 不同，设置了 `score_threshold` 或按分数过滤的调用方需要重新校准。

4. **`reindex` 拒绝非递归的 semantic namespace 请求（#5395）**：`ov reindex viking://user/alice --mode semantic_and_vectors --recursive=false` 以前会忽略 `recursive=false` 并递归重建整个命名空间，现在返回 `INVALID_ARGUMENT`。请对具体的 resource、memory 或 skill 目录发起请求。

5. **`/health` 对无效凭证返回认证错误（#5471）**：不带凭证的请求仍返回 200；显式带了过期或无效 API key 时，以前返回匿名 200，现在返回认证错误。用无效 key 探活的脚本需要去掉凭证。

6. **Gemini SDK 最低版本（#5428、#5439）**：`gemini`、`gemini-async` extras 的 `google-genai` 要求升到 `>=1.39.0`。更低版本的 SDK 会在 `embed_async()` 报 `TypeError`、`close()` 报 `AttributeError`。

7. **安装器行为变化（#5464、#5477、#5498）**：默认安装不再 `git clone`；`--dist github`、`--source remote`、`OPENVIKING_REPO_URL/REF/BRANCH` 仍被接受，但只打印提示。Claude Code 2.1.224+ 通过 URL marketplace 自动更新，Claude Code 2.0 以下会被跳过。默认会用 `npm install -g @openviking/cli` 安装 `ov` CLI，需要本机有 npm；不想安装时在勾选项里取消 CLI，或用 `--harness` 指定不含 `cli` 的列表。

## English

### Highlights

- Retrieval and ranking: each query now does one global vector recall and then one unified rerank by mode; directory recursion and parent score propagation are removed, and score thresholds apply after rerank (#5450); hotness weighting and `retrieval.hotness_alpha` are removed (#5454); `find` / `search` add the event time-decay ranking parameter `events_time_decay_protection` (#5214); `search` adds `search_type="keywords"` for BM25 keyword retrieval across REST, MCP, CLI, and the Python / TypeScript / Go SDKs (#5456); Jev rerank adds a Choice mode, enabled with `rerank.mode: "choice"` (the default stays `noul`); Choice scores are relative probabilities within the candidate pool, so set `rerank.threshold` to `0` and pass `min_score=0` for MCP calls (#5486); the observer reports the vector metric and score scale (#5488).
- Filesystem and knowledge consolidation: `ls` / `tree` return a `has_more` pagination flag (#5330); `tree` supports `directories_only` and L0/L1 content (#5334); `ls` supports `include_abstract` / `include_overview` (#5434); `ov compile --skill memory` deduplicates, merges, and normalizes a memory directory in place (#5178); `reindex` moves to the RFV planner, adds `force`, makes async tasks recoverable, and `queue_workers.reindex.max_concurrent` defaults to `4` (#5416); snapshots handle files replaced by directories (#5441); Markdown parsing keeps content before the first top-level heading (#5427) and Feishu tables escape pipes and line breaks (#5435).
- MCP, permissions, and Studio: MCP tools advertise behavior annotations (#5075) and whole-call failures return `isError: true` (#5078); adds the `list_users`, `list_groups`, `get_acl`, and `set_acl` tools, and `write` / `add_resource` accept `acl` (#5466); account mutations are refused when the registry baseline is missing, so existing accounts are not overwritten (#5483); `ovcli.conf` accepts `oidc_token` (#5448); Studio adds account-level memory extraction rule editing (#5495).
- Models and vector services: gpt-6 and later OpenAI models are treated as reasoning models, fixing session commit 400 errors (#5398); extra request bodies are forwarded for Volcengine, Ark media responses, and Anthropic through LiteLLM (#5432, #5440, #5447); Gemini async clients are created per request, fixing `attached to a different loop` (#5428); the Jina default dimension is derived from the model (#5426); the in-memory cache provider rejects Lua scripts (#5446).
- Agent plugins: capture filtering is unified as sanitize → filter → truncate across pi / Codex / DSH / OpenCode / Claude Code (#5359, #5375); Claude Code and Codex recall hooks forward `recallExcludeUris` (#5407) and pi honors `recallExcludeUris` / `recallQueryFilters` (#5368); Codex capture excludes host-injected startup context (#5392); pi `/viking commit` explains why nothing was archived (#5468); pi and OpenCode ship OpenViking skills (#5525); adds the `ov-kanban` skill for structured task handoff (#5157, #5451); DSH adds the plugin card icon and localized descriptions (#5362) and resolves workspace peer settings per session (#5380); Hermes fixes recall binding to the current session and preserves unrelated `.env` content during setup (#5372, #5374, #5449, #5455).
- Installation: the installer installs from the release channel only, no longer runs `git clone`, and lists what it will change before changing anything (#5464); installer files are downloaded from the docs site, using whichever of `docs.openviking.net` and `docs.openviking.ai` answers first (#5477, #5487); the `ov` CLI is installed by default (#5498); the installer asks for the language first and clears old installers' leftovers (#5490); guides and plugin READMEs use `openviking.ai/install` as the install entry (#5478).
- CLI, docs, and branding: the CLI adopts the E mark and solid colors (#5545); the README gets an agent-first Quick Start and an entry to the Volcengine OpenViking Service product page (#5524); the docs site is reviewed page by page against the implementation (#5501–#5511, #5533, #5534); open-font typography (#5536, #5543) and the E branding (#5537, #5546).
- Other fixes: when the Bot runs through an intermediate launcher such as Windows + uv, its ready state was misjudged and the main server waited 900 seconds (#5431).

### Compatibility and Migration

1. **Session auto-commit settings merged (#5363):** `memory.session_auto_commit.default_enabled` and `idle_enabled` are merged into `enabled` (default `false`). The old key names are not compatible and are ignored, with only an `Ignoring unknown config field` WARNING in the startup log and no error. Deployments that set the old keys will have auto-commit turned off after upgrading and must set `enabled: true`. In the same block, `scan_batch_size` and `scan_batch_pause_seconds` are removed in favor of `scan_rate_limit_files_per_second` (default `2.0`), and the default `check_interval_seconds` changes from `60` to `600` seconds.

   ```json
   { "memory": { "session_auto_commit": { "enabled": true } } }
   ```

2. **Known issue: `find` with invalid parameters returns 500 instead of 400:** a negative `limit` returns 500 on both the local vector backend and the VikingDB backend (on the local backend the native search call overflows on a negative topk); `limit=0` returns 500 on the VikingDB backend and an empty result on the local backend (introduced by #5450). On the VikingDB backend, a `filter` condition without `op` also returns 500 (already the case since v0.4.22). Parameter validation will be added in a later release; until then, callers should keep `limit >= 1` and include `op` in every `filter` condition.

3. **Retrieval scoring and ordering changes (#5450, #5454):** recall changes from per-level recursion with parent score propagation to a single global recall; the candidate pool grows to `2 × limit` only when rerank is enabled, rerank runs once, and vector scores are used if rerank fails. The `retrieval.hotness_alpha` and `score_propagation_alpha` settings are removed; leftover entries are ignored with a WARNING, and ordering uses only vector or rerank scores. Result order and scores for the same query may differ from v0.4.22, so callers using `score_threshold` or score filters should recalibrate.

4. **`reindex` rejects non-recursive semantic namespace requests (#5395):** `ov reindex viking://user/alice --mode semantic_and_vectors --recursive=false` used to ignore `recursive=false` and rebuild the whole namespace recursively; it now returns `INVALID_ARGUMENT`. Send the request to a specific resource, memory, or skill directory instead.

5. **`/health` returns an authentication error for invalid credentials (#5471):** requests without credentials still get 200. Requests that explicitly present an expired or invalid API key used to get an anonymous 200 and now get an authentication error. Probes that send an invalid key should drop the credentials.

6. **Minimum Gemini SDK version (#5428, #5439):** the `gemini` and `gemini-async` extras now require `google-genai>=1.39.0`. Older SDKs raise `TypeError` in `embed_async()` and `AttributeError` in `close()`.

7. **Installer behavior changes (#5464, #5477, #5498):** the default install no longer runs `git clone`; `--dist github`, `--source remote`, and `OPENVIKING_REPO_URL/REF/BRANCH` are still accepted but only print a notice. Claude Code 2.1.224+ updates through a URL marketplace, and Claude Code older than 2.0 is skipped. The `ov` CLI is installed by default with `npm install -g @openviking/cli`, which needs npm on the machine; to skip it, uncheck the CLI item or pass a `--harness` list without `cli`.

## First-time Contributors

- @MohammadHijjawi97 — https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5398
- @JayOfTheKeyboard — https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5448
- @fukalous — https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5471

Full Changelog: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/compare/v0.4.22...v0.4.23

name: v0.38.2
body:
### Bug Fixes

- Fixed **auth vault login** to pick usable controls when hidden duplicates exist, and to bind credential entry to the selected field so replaced fields or redirected focus are rejected before submitting (#2014)
- Fixed **chat mode** to allow `webmcp`, `skills`, and other top-level browser commands, so the model uses page WebMCP tools instead of falling back to `eval` (#2015)
- Fixed **Kernel profiles** so `KERNEL_PROFILE_NAME` sessions send the profile as an object instead of failing with a 400, and added `KERNEL_PROFILE_SAVE_CHANGES` to opt into saving changes back (#2004)
- Fixed **Chrome freezing after launch** by draining its stderr for the browser's lifetime, so a full log pipe no longer blocks the browser (#2003)
- Fixed **Browser Use** by switching to Cloud V4, which creates, attaches to, and stops the same browser with bounded timeouts (#1879)
- Fixed **Vercel Sandbox shared memory detection** by measuring `/dev/shm` capacity and adding `--disable-dev-shm-usage` below 256 MiB, so Chrome no longer terminates renderers on the undersized mount (#1890)

### Improvements

- Upgraded the **eve integration** from eve 0.47.3 to 0.57.0, so apps on eve 0.50 and later build again (#1945)

name: v0.90.0
body:
**Provider-native web search**

### Highlights

- Web search now uses your model provider's own server-side search (Anthropic and OpenAI) by default instead of scraping from your machine, shown as regular web search rows live and on resume (thanks @johnnyfish)

### Improvements

- Set websearch.prefer_native = false or JCODE_WEBSEARCH_PREFER_NATIVE=0 to keep using local search engines
- Provider-side search follows each session's allowed and disabled tool policy
- SDK apps that register their own websearch tool keep it instead of having it replaced by provider search
- Installing a skill mid-session no longer invalidates the prompt cache, so the next turn stays fast and cheap
- When switching providers, earlier native search results are summarized clearly so the model does not retract correct answers

### Fixes

- OpenAI login validation no longer hangs when the account hits a usage limit
- Retrying a turn no longer leaves web search rows from the aborted attempt
- Interrupted Anthropic turns that used native search no longer risk a request error on the next message

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.89.3...v0.90.0

name: Skill 4.5.0
body:
- **Working screens look finished.** Dashboards, boards and tools commit to a real palette, keep the controls your users already know, and are held to the cleanest product in their category. The chosen world adds one signature detail on top, such as service health drawn as a transit map.

- **Docs keep a calm column.** On documentation, guides and articles, the world owns the frame: masthead, sidebar, title and the way code is set. The text you read stays in a plain, readable column.

- **The action comes first.** A landing page now shows the thing its visitors came to do in working form, like a flight search or open appointment slots, instead of a button that points somewhere else.

- **Rules arrive on time.** The rules for each kind of page print the moment directions are dealt, so every comp follows them, including comps made in parallel.

- **Fixes.** Ignore entries now land where git reads them in a linked worktree. Live mode keeps checkpoints in order across tabs. Padding findings no longer treat an unresolved CSS variable as zero. Images hidden inside SVG definitions count toward the text-only hero check.

name: impeccable engine engine-v0.1.11

name: Skill 4.4.0
body:
- **Review the component kit in your browser.** Each illustration, photo and rendered component sits next to its crop of the comp. Approve it, or say what needs fixing and the agent repairs it for the next round. Repeated pieces, like a row of cards, are reviewed together. Approvals carry over between rounds, and a component whose files change is reviewed again.

- **Then check the first screen.** Once the page is assembled, you review the first viewport against the comp. Accepting it closes review for that build; the agent finishes the rest in the same direction. When nobody is at the keyboard, the review waits for you instead of approving itself.

- **Apps look like apps.** On dashboards, tools and docs, the chosen direction now shapes type, color accents, density and one signature detail, while navigation, tables, charts and controls stay the standard kind your users already know. Landing pages and portfolios still get the full treatment.

- **Variants on request.** The new `/impeccable generate` command takes one sentence, like “generate 3 bold variants of the pricing cards”, finds the element on your open page and has the variants cycling in your browser within about a minute. Accept one and it becomes source code.

- **Findings you can trust.** Line length, padding and three other rendered checks now measure the lines and boxes the browser actually draws, and each finding names the screen width it fired at. Pale placeholder text is caught. Colors defined in your `DESIGN.md` are no longer flagged as a generic AI palette, and Tailwind spinners no longer count as accent borders.

- **Touch gets tested by touch.** `adapt`, `audit` and `harden` now exercise each control’s primary gesture instead of accepting a resized screenshot as proof.

- **No false update notices.** Current installs stop reporting that an update is available.

## Contributors

Thanks to @Feighery89, @injaneity, @r33drichards, @ZenAlexa for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.
